text:
Claire H: Quick sync — proposing a focused sprint to produce a Cloud Partner IaC starter kit (reference arch + Terraform modules + marketplace packaging notes). Goal: give partners a copy-paste repo to onboard Redwood into AWS/GCP marketplaces.
Adarsh K: +1. Can you scope top-level deliverables? thinking: 1) Terraform modules (network, compute, deployment), 2) example app + helm chart, 3) CI for publishing, 4) docs + diagram, 5) test matrix for instance types.
Claire H: Exactly those. Also need a short checklist for partner ops (KMS, licensing, billing flags) and a small troubleshooting/runbook.
Leah S: Suggest minimal refarch should include VPC with private subnets, EKS cluster + ALB, S3 for artifacts, and a managed DB option (RDS). Keep defaults small.
Juan M: I'll own testing on Ampere/Graviton flavors and add cost-profile notes. I can validate performance on g5 vs a1 families.
Mikayla P: This will be used by bizdev when onboarding marketplace partners. Acceptance criteria: "repo can deploy end-to-end in a partner sandbox with <= 15 min of manual setup" and docs with screenshots + one-liner install command.
Adarsh K: Proposed 3-week schedule: Week 1 — module scaffolding + CI; Week 2 — example app + helm + docs; Week 3 — packaging + partner checklist + testing. Thoughts?
Leah S: Works for me. We should include an examples/ directory with two variants: minimal and production-ish.
Adarsh K: Module layout (draft):
```
modules/
  vpc/
    main.tf
    variables.tf
    outputs.tf
  eks/
  marketplace-pkg/
examples/
  minimal/
  with-rds/
ci/
  publish.yml  # GH Actions example
README.md
LICENSE
docs/architecture.png
```
Claire H: Good. For the Terraform snippet in README, use something simple for partners to copy:
```
module "redwood_marketplace" {
  source        = "github.com/redwood/inference-iac//modules/marketplace-pkg"
  region        = var.region
  instance_type = var.instance_type
  env           = "partner-sandbox"
}
```
Juan M: For CI, we should include a step that runs `terraform validate` + `tflint` + `terratest` (go tests). Add a publish script that creates the marketplace bundle (tar.gz) and uploads to partner S3 bucket.
Mikayla P: Partner checklist items: partner_kms_enabled, accept_tos_url, billing_account_id, support_contact, legal_approved=true. We'll keep a template partners.yaml.
Adarsh K: We'll need a short note on license and redistribution. Use Apache-2.0 for code, and a short partner agreement template (not legal final).
Claire H: Security note — default TF variables must not include secrets. Add example KMS integration in docs and show how to swap in customer KMS.
partner-bot: (automated) Reminder: weekly partnerships sync in #partnerships is 2026-04-02 15:00 UTC.
Leah S: Quick question — do we target both AWS & GCP in the first pass or do AWS only then port the patterns to GCP?
Mikayla P: Prefer AWS-first (marketshare + dev time), but leave a GCP checklist and reference module names. We can add a gcp/ directory in week 3 if time.
Adarsh K: Agree. AWS-first, with modular abstractions so a follow-up GCP module is straightforward.
Juan M: Testing matrix I'll track in a spreadsheet: instance types, region, AMI/accelerator, tf version. I'll share link once created.
Claire H: Owners: Adarsh = engineering lead, Leah = infra patterns + examples, Juan = perf/testing, Mikayla = partners requirements & docs. I'll coordinate external partner contacts and approvals.
Adarsh K: I'll open the repo today and draft README + module skeleton by Fri. Will create GH project with columns: backlog / in-progress / review / done.
Mikayla P: I'll prepare the partners.yaml template and the acceptance criteria doc.
Claire H: OK — next touchpoint: Friday 11:00 PT for initial skeleton review. Please add any blockers to the GH project and ping me if you need sandbox creds.
Leah S: ✅
Juan M: ✅ I'll start with Ampere test harness.
Adarsh K: ✅
Mikayla P: ✅
Claire H: Thanks team :rocket:
